metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: NINPEI crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C42 H42 F39 La3 O42 Ti6,2.75(C4 H8 O1). From the CIF bond table, La1 (La) has 8 O neighbors; Ti1 (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; Ti2 (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; La2 (La) has 9 O neighbors; Ti3 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti1A (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; Ti2A (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; La2A (La) has 9 O neighbors; Ti3A (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; La1D (La) has 8 O neighbors; Ti1D (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; Ti2D (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; La2D (La) has 9 O neighbors; Ti3D (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti1E (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; Ti2E (Ti) has 5 O neighbors; La2E (La) has 9 O neighbors; Ti3E (Ti) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 86 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 1.923-4.900 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 40.42-173.59°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [La3Ti6O4(OH)6(C2F3O2)13(H2O)2(C4H8O)6]. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 6 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
